plugins.name: taiwan-legal
plugins.description: Access layer for Taiwan legal open data: court judgments (judicial.gov.tw), the National Regulation Database (law.moj.gov.tw), Constitutional Court rulings, ministries' administrative interpretations (函釋), Supreme Court resolutions / precedents, administrative appeal and Fair Trade Commission decisions, and legislative reasons (立法理由). Bundles the open-source mcp-taiwan-legal-db MCP server. Use when you need to search and retrieve Taiwanese court rulings, statutory text, or interpretive authority.
